reviews.review_text:
Kelly Trang
Hanoi, Vietnam7 contributions
0
Semi buffet at Japanese hotel in Hanoi
Sep 2025 • Family
A warm and lovely meal with my family! This is not my first time to dine at this restaurant. Friendly, attentive and professional service. Nice food with decent menu. Cozy, private and pleasant atmosphere. All of these are the reasons to make me keep coming back. We are all not big eaters. The semi-buffet is just a perfect choice. Not a huge selection of dishes but each is well cooked and unique such as perilla juice. Sashimi must be the busiest area including salmon, tuna. They are fresh (which is super important to me!) and refilled often (another key point at buffet meal!). California rolls are delicious. My baby enjoys a lot seeing how chef Huyen made them right next to our table! I also ordered some additional main courses to share with a portion of salmon and wagyu steak. The wasabi sauce paired with the steak was impressive! Must-try! I would recommend a rotation of menu or seasonal dishes to keep refreshing dining experience. In general the meal is very worthy. Thank you Ms Hanh, Mr Chinh, chef Huyen, Ms An for help us enjoy the most of our time at the Voyage restaurant. And love their pastry counter with burned cheese or matcha cheese cake, orange cake, chocolate cut and roll cake 🥰🥰🥰
